campaign.title: Exploit ordered odd-denominator resonance cells in M1

conductor_policy.monitoring: Keep chi_4 inside the ordered denominator phase. Separate nonresonant and resonant increments with exact widths and total cell cost. Compare every claimed gain with U_1 and the accepted Poisson cone.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close after the exact two-step decomposition, a full exponent-capacity calculation, a hard-top control, and a hostile/source applicability verdict.

numerical_purpose: falsify a resonance-cell count or cancellation claim
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Finite resonance tables are diagnostic only.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only and distinguish real reciprocal phases from modular inverses.

frozen_target.exact_identity: chi_4(d)=-i e(d/4) for odd d and g_h(d+2)-g_h(d)=1/2-2hX/(d(d+2)).
frozen_target.success: Prove a new subset of U_1, isolate a strictly smaller resonance-cell lemma, or prove equivalence/no capacity relative to the accepted M1 transform.

campaign.promotion_policy: A resonance decomposition promotes only if its summed cell bounds improve the accepted phase diagram or establish a rigorous scoped no-go.
